formatClaims.detail: spdx-2.3 is reproducible and each document is addressed by its sha256 and size, which --check re-derives, but its bytes are not committed: supply/sboms is held under 40 MB, and with development dependencies the CycloneDX 1.7 documents take 21.1 MB and the SPDX 2.3 documents 22.0 MB

syft 1.55.0 (spdx-json@3.0) orders the @graph and numbers the local identifiers of its SPDX 3.0.1 document differently on each run of the same tree, so its bytes are validated and counted but cannot be committed as a reproducible projection
